note: Distilled per-build summary of issue #132's lever matrix. Row 0 is the committed layout (the graded T1 item-5 evidence); rows 1-6 are candidate builds in the gitignored flow/build/ scratch tree and are NOT claims about layout/modexp.def. 'corners_closed' counts corners with timing_status == 'constrained' and non-negative setup AND hold slack at a 10.0 ns period. Verbatim klt sta envelopes for every row are alongside this file.
